39. 當 $0^\circ \le x \le 360^\circ$ 時，方程 $7\sin^2 x = \sin x$ 有多少個根？

A. 2

B. 3

C. 4

D. 5
reasoning:
The equation $7\sin^2 x = \sin x$ can be rearranged to $7\sin^2 x - \sin x = 0$, which factors as $\sin x (7\sin x - 1) = 0$. 
1) $\sin x = 0$ has 3 solutions in the range $0^\circ \le x \le 360^\circ$: $x = 0^\circ, 180^\circ, 360^\circ$. 
2) $\sin x = 1/7$ has 2 solutions in the range $0^\circ \le x \le 360^\circ$, one in the first quadrant and one in the second quadrant. 
Total number of roots = $3 + 2 = 5$.
